name: Suspension corner: hardpoints, arm structure and bush compliance in one loop
description: pinneapple_design.suspension.study.suspension_study: the double-wishbone hardpoints, the arm's tube and the bushings searched together for the lightest corner that meets a static margin, a camber-gain band, a bump-steer limit and a steer compliance, with the closed-loop multibody solve, the elastokinematic bush modes and the 3-D finite-element check of the winning arm.

params.title: Suspension corner: sizing, kinematics and bush compliance
